title: GLM-5.3 NVFP4 on eight Sparks
evidence_scope: GLM-5.3 (744B, GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM) at tensor-parallel size 8 with decode-context parallelism 4, a 1,048,576-token context, 16 sequences, 43 GiB of fp8_ds_mla KV cache per Spark, two-token MTP speculative decoding, MXFP8 dense linears on the B12X linear backend, W4A16 experts, the compressed-KV gather, the vLLM plugins glm_dsa_indexer_split and glm53full_speedups, and the vLLM plugin glm_dcp_decode_comm loaded with its five items off, on SIRCL ring sessions with NCCL off, the fused all-reduce and RMSNorm and 16 link slots of 512 KiB, on all eight Sparks of an eight-Spark ring. It installs only with an image lock (v3) whose image carries the SIRCL layer and lists the three plugins in vllm_plugins; no image lock in this package does (runtime/images/derive_glm53_plugins.py builds one). A launch outside sparkring install with these settings and 8 sequences, on image af06e272 (the SIRCL 0.3.0 and libsircl image 816c6d6a7e96 with that plugin layer's first two plugins; glm_dcp_decode_comm was not loaded) with SM clocks locked at 2,418 MHz on one eight-Spark ring, decoded 48.0 / 69.6 / 103.2 / 151.2 tokens/s at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 streams at 0K context and 44.4 / 62.9 / 93.2 / 129.0 at 16K, and prefilled about 1,290 tokens/s at 16K; 16 sequences kept 1-8-stream steps/s within 3 % and gave 216.9 tokens/s at 16 streams at 0K (2026-10-09; no record of these runs is in performance/records). No installation of this profile has run on hardware. Not serving-qualified.
